description: This Java class 'AuthorizationModelFactory' provides factory methods for creating immutable authorization-related objects such as AuthorizationSubject and AuthorizationContext, including methods for creating contexts from JSON representations and with various parameters.

classes.name: AuthorizationModelFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing static factory methods for creating authorization models such as subjects and contexts.

methods.name: newAuthSubject
methods.description: Creates a new immutable AuthorizationSubject with the specified identifier.

methods.name: emptyAuthContext
methods.description: Creates a new immutable empty AuthorizationContext.

methods.name: newAuthContext
methods.description: Creates a new immutable AuthorizationContext with a specified type, authorization subject, and optional additional subjects.

methods.name: newAuthContext
methods.description: Deprecated method for creating AuthorizationContext with a single subject and optional additional subjects.

methods.name: newAuthContext
methods.description: Creates a new AuthorizationContext from a JSON object.

methods.name: newAuthContext
methods.description: Creates a new AuthorizationContext with a specified type and a collection of authorization subjects.

methods.name: newAuthContext
methods.description: Deprecated method for creating AuthorizationContext with an iterable of subjects.
